scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test:desktop: bun scripts/desktop/fixtures.ts --check && bun scripts/desktop/check-bindings.ts && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace
scripts.verify:desktop: bun run build:desktop && cargo fmt --all --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun run test:desktop
scripts.bindings:desktop: cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked -p song-session --example bindings -- src/generated/desktop
